scope: Compile the unchanged main with native XLA. Disable task assignment only for the separately compiled observer and its required producers. For a declared identity main, forward input directly. Split_on uses identical graph boundaries and native assignment for both.
selection: Fixed mappings are free. Each adaptive choice includes querying current OS affinity and traversing its frozen rule. Cost includes every selected component build and one end-to-end ready latency times N.
train: As registered in scoped_assignment.json, minimize the discovery mean of log paired total-cost ratios at N=1000 using the same tree fitter as the packed panel. Tie preference J, S, split_off.
endpoint: All 4 reserved structures x 2 sizes x 3 affinities = 24 cells, equal weight. Per cell median paired total-cost ratio over 5 processes, then geometric mean across cells. Strongest simple comparator has lowest aggregate cost ratio against native J at N=1000. A method claim requires ratio <= 0.95 against that comparator, all chosen output checks valid, and zero resolved native-J latency harms at default affinity. Raw and invalid cells remain visible. Publish each policy and group and every budget irrespective of outcome.
